about: The ONE list of study slots, schema 0.4 (V2, Codex Q1-Q9 at c3a128ee). FROZEN (study_spend.py FROZEN_DEFINITIONS_SHA256): everything except, for rows other than the frozen-whole S1/S2/P1a/PRIOR, the mutable fields status, receipt, invalid_reason, admission, attempts, cancellation and closure, and the append-only attempt_rows list. Only `study_spend.py --admit` sets a row RUNNING (with its admission record: valid 300 s, one RunInstances attempt); the runner then fills the receipt and sets DONE (or INVALID with a reason), or closes an unused admission as CLOSED_NO_LAUNCH, and commits. A never-admitted row may be CANCELLED_NOT_LAUNCHED. A retry is a new attempt row with its own admission. Moves are forward-only against every committed version. Money strings are exact US dollars.

owner_stop.rule: before every admission while fewer than 3 main training attempts (rows marked counts_toward_training_stop) have started an instance: if the spend upper bound is strictly greater than $30.00, stop: every admission is refused and the runner reports to the owner. Settled rows only move forward, so once triggered the stop stays triggered
owner_stop.counting: Codex Q3/Q6: only the main-comparison training attempts of M1-M6 (and their attempt rows) count; the normal third is M3 after M1 and M2. Every main attempt whose hash-verified receipt, bound to its admission, shows a launched instance counts, accepted or not, failed or repeated, with no reset. A RunInstances refusal proven to create no instance, and a CLOSED_NO_LAUNCH row proven to create none, do not count (their cost does). An uncertain start blocks every admission. The smoke runs S1 and S2 and the prerequisite jobs do not count; their costs do

allowances.basis: coordinator decision: a stated S3/transfer/retention allowance of $0.10 per job, added on top of the machine+address+disk bound (watched jobs) or on top of the training launcher's own $1.48 ancillary allowance (training jobs). It covers S3 requests, transfer out of AWS and 12 months of storage of up to about 0.36 GB of retained objects at $0.023 per GB-month. Measured sizes today: S2 retains 49,097,828 bytes of artifacts; P1a stored a 10,230,760-byte bundle plus about 1 MB of uploads. No better measured figure exists; no provider invoice is read. LIMIT: storage is covered for 12 months only; the evidence buckets are kept with no end date (DELETION_DENIED), so storage after 12 months is OUTSIDE this bound (open question 5).

open_questions_for_owner_or_codex: 1 INCLUDED, SCOPE OPEN (FLAG_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW): the earlier preparation jobs in this design folder (analogy_repair_t4_job attempt 1 $0.5596 and attempt 2 $0.67, aws_probe_job $0.4834, hset1a_aws_job attempt 1 $0.0223 and attempt 2 $0.1827; total $1.9180, watcher figures, not program-validated) are counted conservatively as the prior-spend row PRIOR ($1.92), per Codex 'Envelope consequences' (c3a128ee). Whether they belong inside the $60.00 stays the owner's scope decision. The $0.10 allowance per job (+$0.50) is not added; the state file shows that total.

2 DECIDED (Codex Q2): the $60.00 caps study charges, bounded across all attempts and required remaining work (this program's worst-case spend). The $15.00 launcher bookings are bookkeeping reservations, not invoices; they are never refunded or rewritten; C's $90 and B's $120 booking figures do not raise the ceiling; the canonical campaign cap must also pass on its own (outside this program).
3 DECIDED (Codex Q3/Q6): the third main attempt is normally M3 after M1 and M2; the stop counts every main attempt that started an instance (see owner_stop.counting).

4 DECIDED (Codex Q1): the S1 capacity-refusal accounting rule is ACCEPTED, conditional on the pinned provider failure evidence (provider_0025.json, sha256 d866fbf5...), zero retries, no instance or volume left and the temporary resources removed; the program names that evidence with every report. S1's canonical $15 booking stays. Never reused for an ambiguous launched job.

5 OPEN (FLAG_FOR_HUMAN_REVIEW): the $0.10 allowance covers 12 months of retention; the plan's horizon was execution + 30 days after E1; the evidence buckets have no end date. Codex: keep both assumptions visible; reconcile object sizes, transfer, requests and retention before the final freeze; report ongoing charges beyond the bound.

6-9 DECIDED (Codex Q6-Q9): a launched-then-failed main job counts as started; a never-admitted row may be CANCELLED_NOT_LAUNCHED; a wrong source, bundle, worker or checker invalidates the result and blocks the study while cleanup is still inspected; one admission authorizes one RunInstances attempt, and a retry is a new attempt row with its own admission. See REVIEW.md 'v2 (Codex Q1-Q9)'.

10 OPEN (for the runner and the launchers; the gate refuses until they hold): every launcher must write worker_sha256 and checker_sha256 where IDENTITY_FIELDS reads them; the prepare scripts must take the admitted source commit instead of HEAD; the runner runs --launch-check immediately before RunInstances; a training job is prepared after its admission and launched inside the 300-s validity, because its receipt shows no launch time but the job id's preparation time.

slots.scope: E1 runs in every branch of the plan, so it is always reserved. It INCLUDES: (1) collecting the retained evidence of every training slot that ran (the checkpoint and measurement objects each training receipt lists, from the retained buckets or the local receipts, into E1's bundle); (2) the TEST readout, the 18 checkpoint probe reads and the gates; (3) a partial-study readout path: if the study stops early (the $30 stop, a failed seed, or fallback B unfundable) E1 reads whatever checkpoints exist and reports COMPARISON_INCOMPLETE, on the same machine and deadline, so under the same cap
